Harper: Postmortem follow-up: we promised concrete remediation and short timelines for rollout safety. Putting a lightweight action list here. Keep replies +1 if you own, add ETA.
Noah: I'll take the auto-rollback proto and the rollout-state metric. Plan: sketch today, PR by Thu. Question: use relative_error or abs_error for alerts?
Lin: I'll take flag caps and the PR checklist. ETA next Tue. Will include "kill-switch" instructions and runbook snippet.
Priya: I'll own instrumentation for micro-canaries and the dashboard alerts. ETA Mon. Also add a metric for consecutive_rollback_count to detect flapping.
Harper: Quick ground rules: zero-default (deny broad rollout unless team explicitly raises cap), per-flag risk classification, and automated rollback for production-impacting errors.
Noah: proto config I like (discussion strawman):
```
feature_flag:
  id: checkout_new_flow
  risk_level: medium   # low/medium/high
  rollout:
    stages:
      - pct: 0.5
        min_rps: 50
      - pct: 3
        min_rps: 200
      - pct: 15
    monitoring:
      baseline_window_sec: 600
      alert_mode: relative_error  # options: absolute_error, relative_error
      absolute_error_threshold: 0.01
      relative_error_threshold: 0.25
    auto_rollback:
      enabled: true
      mode: relative_error
      cooldown_min: 20
      quarantine_min: 45
```
Priya: note: using 0.5% initial for highly risky flows helps with noise. Also recommend keeping min_rps so tiny pct doesn't trigger on low volume.
Lin: PR checklist items (short): owner/team, risk_level, rollout_stages, min_rps, observable_list (error_rate/p50/p99), rollback_SLA, kill_switch_contact, post-rollback_playbook.
Harper: Rollback SLA proposals: critical endpoints = 2m response time target to rollback; non-critical = 10m. Add to PR checklist.
Noah: For alerting: prefer relative_error for model/perf regressions, absolute_error for hard correctness (5xx). We'll support both.
Priya: Dashboard alerts: create combined alert when (pct_exposed >= 10% OR consecutive_rollback_count >= 2) AND error_delta > threshold. Also add an automated incident doc link in alert.
ops-bot: Created issue INF-5502: "rollout safety: spec + telemetry" assigned @noah, @priya, @lin.
Harper: Ownership quick table:
- Auto-rollback spec + rollout-state metric: Noah (sketch today, PR Thu) / Harper review
- Flag caps + PR checklist: Lin (draft Tue) / Noah review
- Micro-canary instrumentation + alerts: Priya (ETA Mon) / SRE review
- Incident taxonomy entry (cache-eviction pattern): Priya + Lin (add repro eval)

Harper: Small experiments: run 10x synthetic eviction at 5% canary and check p95/p99 delta. Priya to add to CI bench.
Lin: Add a simple kill-switch CLI snippet in the checklist: `redwood flags set checkout_new_flow --pct 0` and include rollback tag in changelog.
Noah: Also: server-side guard that stops canary advance if baseline traffic variance > 30% in past window. Protects against noisy baselines.
Priya: Calendar: 20m sync to walk checklist + telemetry: Wed 09:30 PT.
